   - A blank query lists exactly the 3 actions, then the 17 pages, in order.
   - "pat no" keeps `page-patch-notes` and drops `page-decks`.
   - "DECK" keeps `action-new-deck` and `page-decks` and drops `page-shop`.
   - "zzzzqqq" shows `empty`, and Enter changes nothing.
   - After `await act(() => setLocale("zh-CN"))`, "卡组" keeps `page-decks`, and "decks" drops it.

   - At `/creator`, register `guardLeaving((leave) => held.push(leave))`. Type "Decks" and press Enter: the path stays `/creator`, and one move is held.
   - Calling it goes to `/decks`. Release the guard afterwards.

   - The ids of `commandCards(CATALOG)` equal those of `almanacShelf(CATALOG)` mapped to `card-<id>`.
   - Typing the name of a held card (`!setShips(def.set)`, its name unique to it) lists no option for it. Guard the lookup with `if (held !== undefined)`.

11. **"Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside it".** Input, then Tab to `close`, Tab to the input, Shift+Tab to `close`.
